steps.title: Plate bacteria on TSA
steps.instruction: Streak an isolated colony onto Trypticase Soy Agar (TSA) plates, incubate aerobically at 37 °C for 18–24 h to obtain confluent growth.

steps.title: Prepare dense bacterial suspension
steps.instruction: Suspend the 24‑h culture in 2.2 ml CSB buffer, adjust optical density to D = 7.0 (≈2.1 × 10⁸ cells ml⁻¹) using a sterile polyester‑fiber or cotton swab moistened with sterile CSB; spin the swab gently to disperse cells while minimizing aerosols. Optical density measured with a Densi‑La‑Meter II (Erba Lachema).

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Transfer 1 ml of the bacterial suspension to a microcentrifuge tube, centrifuge 10 min at 7 500 rpm, then carefully discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Lyse cells with ATL
steps.instruction: Add 180 µl Buffer ATL (QIAGEN, catalog #19076) to the pellet, resuspend thoroughly using a 1000 µl pipette tip to avoid cell injury.

steps.title: Digest proteins with Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add either 20 µl Proteinase K (QIAGEN) or 2 µl self‑prepared Proteinase K (20 mg ml⁻¹). Vortex to mix, then incubate 1 h at 56 °C. Use freshly prepared Proteinase K or store at –20 °C before use.

steps.title: Add AL buffer and ethanol
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube for 15 s, add 200 µl Buffer AL (QIAGEN) and pipette up/down repeatedly to obtain a homogeneous solution (prevent gelatinous lysate). Then add 200 µl 96 % ethanol, pipette thoroughly and vortex to mix.

steps.title: First DNA elution
steps.instruction: Place the DNeasy Mini spin column in a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube, pipet 100 µl Buffer AE (QIAGEN, catalog #19077) onto the membrane, incubate at room temperature (23–25 °C) for 2–5 min, then centrifuge 8 000 rpm for 1 min. Collect the eluate (~80–90 µl DNA).

steps.title: Second DNA elution
steps.instruction: Transfer the spin column to a new clean 1.5 ml tube, add another 100 µl Buffer AE, incubate 2–5 min at 23–25 °C, centrifuge 8 000 rpm for 1 min, and collect the second eluate (100–110 µl DNA).
